findings.original: Any one of three conditions implies at most one morphism of Postnikov systems.
findings.adverse_evidence: An explicit length-three pair in D^b(k) has both terminal objects zero, so conditions (1) and (2) hold, but admits two maps over the zero complex map with different nonzero intermediate h.
findings.correction: All three conditions imply terminal-map uniqueness; condition (3) additionally implies uniqueness of the whole map of systems.
findings.limits: This is a uniqueness correction, not a new existence statement.

adverse_interpretations_not_counted_as_d.issue: Literal unsigned projections and literal tower inclusions cannot be mixed without tracking rotation signs.
The second vanishing condition might be misread as implying existence.

reading_observations_not_yet_adjudicated.issue: Shift and index discrepancies in the receiving Postnikov tower, with exact corrected comparison proved in section 7.
